title: CoinGlass 7D data recovery, symbol recognition, and transparent diagnostics
changes: Preserve CoinGlass-only 7D bounds; no 15M proxy or price-crossing source switches.
Repair common decrypted symbol aliases such as BTCUSDT/BTC_USDT_PERP while retaining CoinGlass exact symbol names and existing decrypt reader support.
On verified successful CoinGlass 7D responses save a local read-only last-known snapshot; show previous genuine bounds (marked stale and RR disabled) during subsequent fetch failures or reloads.
Expose fetching/decryption/parsing/coverage status, symbol samples, last version and error in the existing diagnostic panel.
Preserve Pionex WebSocket, chart price sync, 1D indicator logic, RR rules, drawings, 00:00 and 08:00 clocks.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite four frontend files; no Cloudflare Worker, R2, or Pionex_WebSocket changes.
